summary.seg: Incomplete manuscript of the Commedia by Dante Alighieri, 1265-1321, containing the Inferno and the Purgatorio. The contents are somewhat disarranged and some sections are missing.

layout.p: Single column. 21 lines to a page. The ruling is uniform and visible throughout.

decoNote.p: Space has been left for two-line initials at the beginning of each canto; but only the first four have pencilled-in initials. See 1r, 4r and 7v for examples of pencil initials, and 14v and 115r for examples of blank spaces for initials.
Each stanza begins with a displaced 1-line initial.

bindingDesc.p: Red leather binding, with decorative embossing and gold-tooling.

provenance.p:
Former owners include
Reverend Walter Sneyd Sneyd, Reverend Walter and
James Ludovic Lindsay. Lindsay, James Ludovic, 1847-1913

availability.p: The manuscript is available for consultation by any accredited reader.
